title: Thai-Style Masarepa Flatbread
description: A unique twist on traditional flatbread, inspired by Thai flavors and using masarepa. Perfect as a side or snack.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the masarepa and water. Mix well and adjust the water as needed to achieve a dough consistency.
2. Knead the dough for 2-3 minutes, until smooth and pliable.
4. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch (6 mm).
5. Brush the dough with the melted coconut oil and sprinkle with chopped scallions, if using.
6. Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
7. Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, until lightly browned and crispy.
8. Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 2-3 minutes.
9. Cut the flatbread into smaller pieces or use as is.
10. Serve the Thai-Style Masarepa Flatbread warm, garnished with additional chopped scallions if desired.
